# sreagent_alert_mute (Resource)

Silences alerts matching a pattern. Rows cannot be edited, so any change replaces the mute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A mute cannot be edited: any change replaces it.
resource "sreagent_alert_mute" "storage_migration" {
  pattern          = "disk-full"
  reason           = "Planned storage migration"
  duration_minutes = 120
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pattern` (String) The substring to silence, 2 to 200 characters.

### Optional

- `duration_minutes` (Number) 1 to 10080. Omit for a mute that lasts until it is removed. An expired mute stays in state until you remove it from the configuration.
- `reason` (String) Why it is muted.

### Read-Only

- `created_via` (String) Which door created it.
- `ends_at` (String) When the mute stops silencing.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_alert_mute.storage_migration 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
